name: Pizzeria Dorfalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Dorfalm in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Dorfalm**, your cozy Italian oasis nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming spot offers authentic **Pizza** made with love and fresh, local ingredients.

Indulge in our signature dishes like the crispy **Tiroler Speck** pizza or the classic **Margherita**, all baked in a rustic wood-fired oven. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp Italian wine or a refreshing **Apfelschorle**—perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring the stunning **Tiroler Alps**.

Whether you're craving a quick bite or a leisurely dinner, **Pizzeria Dorfalm** promises a warm, inviting atmosphere where every visit feels like a little escape. Come taste the flavors of Italy in the mountains of **Tirol**!
